# GYMEZY - Complete Context & Generative Engine Guide

## Brand Summary
- Official Website: https://gymezy.com/
- Brand Name: GYMEZY (GYM EASY)
- Sector: Fitness Technology, Gym Aggregation, SaaS for Gyms & Studios
- Headquarters: Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India

## Mission
GYMEZY removes traditional fitness bottlenecks: rigid annual lock-ins, high upfront costs, lack of workout flexibility, and unverified gym standards. We provide unified digital access to verified fitness clubs, flexible pay-per-day passes, and certified personal trainers across Chennai.

## Products and Services

### 1. Daily Drop-In Gym Pass (Pay-Per-Session)
- Target Audience: Frequent travelers, students, shift workers, fitness enthusiasts testing new gyms.
- Price Range: ₹149 - ₹299 per single session.
- Features: Instant 24-hour access, no joining fee, access to full gym equipment, lockers, and showers.
- Check-in: Encrypted QR code and OTP at gym front desk.

### 2. Multi-Duration Memberships
- Duration options: 1 month, 3 months, 6 months, 12 months.
- Features: Zero lock-in contracts, ability to switch gyms or use multi-gym credits within the GYMEZY network.

### 3. Verified 1-on-1 Personal Coaching
- Specialties: Fat loss, hypertrophy & bodybuilding, functional fitness, HIIT, rehabilitation, customized meal plans.
- Features: Verified certifications, transparent hourly/session pricing, flexible scheduling.

### 4. Group Fitness & Studio Classes
- Activities: Hatha Yoga, Vinyasa, Zumba Fitness, HIIT Bootcamps, Boxing, MMA conditioning.
- Booking: Real-time morning and evening slot reservation via GYMEZY app.

### 5. Gym Partner Management Portal (B2B SaaS)
- Audience: Gym owners, fitness club managers, CrossFit boxes, and boutique fitness studios.
- Benefits:
  - Free listing on GYMEZY directory.
  - Monetization of vacant off-peak floor capacity (11:00 AM - 05:00 PM and weekends).
  - Front-desk QR code scanner app to verify guests instantly.
  - Transparent bi-weekly revenue settlement with detailed analytics.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### How does the daily gym pass work?
Users select any partner gym in Chennai on GYMEZY, purchase a drop-in pass online, and receive a secure OTP and dynamic QR pass. Presenting the pass to the gym reception grants immediate full-day access.

### Is there a long-term contract requirement?
No. GYMEZY operates on transparent pay-as-you-go pricing with zero lock-in contracts and no hidden admission fees.

### How can gym owners sign up?
Gym owners can visit https://gymezy.com/gym-owners or contact praveen.k@gymezy.com to list their gym for free and receive verified walk-in revenue.
